evidence.observation: Pressure held steady at about 3.15 Torr throughout the 100 sccm ramp.
During growth, pressure rose steadily from 3.188 to 3.526 Torr, and the rise is getting faster.
Ar flow stayed at about 100 sccm, so the flow did not cause the pressure rise.
Temperature is holding at 750 °C with heater power steady at about 44%, so the thermal side looks normal.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so the atmosphere cannot be checked during growth.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 or leak check would tell a seal leak (air getting in) from an exhaust blockage. Options: a leak-up/rate-of-rise test with the valve isolated, a check of the exhaust line or pump conductance, or connecting an O2 sensor.
